execution.backend_resolution: resolved at launch by rust_world_search.resolve_backend (escape hatch: CARC_PROBE_FORCE_PYTHON=1)
execution.continuation_tree_policy: PERSISTING — the playout calls best_action(), which never clears NeuralMCTS._nodes, so ONE tree spans every ply to terminal. On the rust backend this is carc_rs.PersistentSearcher via rust_agent.RustCarryClairvoyantAgent, NOT MirrorState.search_single (which is fresh-tree only and would be a different player).

execution.identity_gate: measurement/rustport_p6/GATE_ORACLE_PILOT_BACKEND.json — this harness's own _process record, python vs rust, every non-timing field as raw f64 bits
execution.seam: ONE determinized world's search (fair_agent.search_one_world -> MirrorState.search_single). Determinization draw, pooling (_merge_root_stats) and decision rule (pooled_q_argmax) stay in Python and are the SAME function objects on both backends.
execution.threads_note: per-world search_single is SINGLE-THREADED; these probes are game-parallel farms, so rust_threads applies only to the whole-agent parity check

goal: Convert CL-070's 'the move changed' into 'the move improved' on a 20-position pilot, and measure the world-CRN variance reduction that decides whether the full ~652-position probe is powered.

rev_license.note: ⚠️ THIS LEG SPANS TWO REVS. The pair is enumerated in merge_legs.LICENSED_TRANCHE_REVS and the instrument diff between the two revs was RE-DERIVED at merge time.
